items.author: Joe Hudson
items.text:
A paradox most people don't realize:

It’s impossible to succeed publicly if you don’t actually want to be seen.
If you don't want to be seen, it means you haven't seen yourself.

items.author: who owns the context
items.text:
Finally seeing a degree through to the end as a new mother in my 30s, I chose the social bullies: accounting and computing.

As my youngest prepares for her final ever school exam, I am feeling a little reflective about that choice.

The bullies are still bullies, what can I say.

items.author: Pico Iyer
items.text: Cars give us freedom of movement, but public transportation—or walking or cycling—gives us that much more important thing, freedom of mind: the ability to do nothing, or anything, and to be completely in possession of our greatest asset, our attention.
